evals.prompt: I'm about to install a new skill I found online. Can you run a security audit on it first? The skill directory is at: /home/itbrda/dev/adponte/saas/.claude/skills/skill-security-auditor/evals/fixtures/clean-skill
evals.expected_output: A security audit report showing CLEAN or INFO-only findings. The report should confirm the skill is safe to install, with no CRITICAL, HIGH, or MEDIUM findings. The report must include a clear verdict (SAFE TO INSTALL), an executive summary, and a summary table.
assertions: The report includes a verdict of SAFE TO INSTALL or equivalent clean verdict
No CRITICAL, HIGH, or MEDIUM severity findings are reported
The report includes an executive summary section
The output is structured as a security report with severity sections
The report identifies all files in the skill directory

evals.prompt: Before I add this skill to my setup, audit it for security problems: /home/itbrda/dev/adponte/saas/.claude/skills/skill-security-auditor/evals/fixtures/risky-skill
evals.expected_output: A security audit report flagging CRITICAL and HIGH findings including: the remote script pipe execution (curl | bash), a hardcoded credential (API_KEY), crontab persistence, .bashrc modification, sensitive environment variables sent to a remote server, global package install, world-writable permissions, and global git config changes. The verdict must be DO NOT INSTALL.
assertions: At least one CRITICAL finding is reported
At least one HIGH finding is reported
The remote script pipe execution (curl ... | bash) in setup.sh is flagged
The hardcoded API_KEY or SECRET_TOKEN credential is flagged
The crontab installation or persistence pattern is flagged
The shell startup file modification (.bashrc) is flagged
The curl command sending environment variables ($USER, $HOME, $PATH) to a remote server is flagged
The verdict is DO NOT INSTALL or equivalent
Each finding includes a file:line reference
Each finding includes a remediation recommendation

evals.prompt: Can you check if this skill is safe to install? Path: /home/itbrda/dev/adponte/saas/.claude/skills/skill-security-auditor/evals/fixtures/mixed-skill
evals.expected_output: A security audit report with MEDIUM and LOW findings including: yaml.load() without safe Loader, os.system() usage, insecure tempfile.mktemp() usage, and external HTTP requests to hardcoded URLs. No CRITICAL findings. The verdict should be REVIEW REQUIRED.
assertions: The report includes at least one MEDIUM or LOW severity finding
No CRITICAL findings are reported
yaml.load() without Loader is detected in bootstrap.py
os.system() usage is detected in bootstrap.py
tempfile.mktemp() is flagged as insecure in bootstrap.py
External HTTP requests or downloads are noted
The verdict is REVIEW REQUIRED or similar (not SAFE TO INSTALL, not DO NOT INSTALL)
The summary table is included with finding counts by severity
